output.summary: The original request (CL-01/CL-03, SH-CS) framed this as needing better apology-reply drafting for double-charge complaints. Investigation rejected that framing (H-COMMUNICATION-GAP REJECTED) and confirmed the real root cause (H-IDEMPOTENCY-MISCONFIG CONFIRMED): on 2026-09-09 a payments engineer disabled gateway idempotency-key enforcement (CHG-77, E-02) for temporary latency debugging. Duplicate captures began exactly then, tracking timeout-retries 1:1 (E-01), because retries after that date lacked idempotency keys while pre-change retries had them and were deduplicated by the PSP (E-03); this drove a ~25-30x spike in double-charge tickets from week W37 (E-04). The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: a read-only monitoring/verification capability (checking duplicate captures, idempotency-key presence, and ticket volume) was built and run, but the actual fix (re-enabling the setting) was not executed, because the DEFINE gate only reached CONDITIONAL_PASS with three verification obligations still open and blocking that protected action.
key_points: Original stakeholder request (CL-01/CL-03) sought an apology-reply assistant, framing the problem as communication quality (E-06); this was rejected (H-COMMUNICATION-GAP REJECTED) against E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05.
Root cause CONFIRMED (H-IDEMPOTENCY-MISCONFIG): SH-PAY disabled idempotency_key_enforcement via change CHG-77 on 2026-09-09 for temporary latency debugging, never rolled back (E-02).
Duplicate captures were 0 on 2026-09-07/08 despite 121/117 timeout retries, then exactly matched retry counts (118/124) on 2026-09-09/10, pinpointing the onset date (E-01).

Pre-change retries (2026-09-01..08) all carried idempotency keys and were fully deduplicated by the PSP (238/238); post-change retries (2026-09-09..10) all lacked keys, producing all 242 duplicate charges (E-03).
Double-charge tickets spiked ~25-30x (9-11/week to 288-301/week) in the same window, tying the customer-facing surge to the technical cause, not reply quality (E-04).

What was released: a read-only monitoring/verification capability (verify_duplicate_captures_stopped on payments-db, verify_retries_carry_idempotency_key on psp-logs, monitor_double_charge_ticket_volume on crm-tickets); the mutating fix action set_capture_idempotency was NOT executed in this release.
Decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION because the DEFINE gate result was CONDITIONAL_PASS, with deferred verification obligations keeping the protected action out of scope.
limitations_explained: The gateway fix (re-enabling idempotency enforcement) was not applied in this release; it would prevent future duplicates but does not remediate the 242 orders already duplicate-charged since 2026-09-09, 4 of which remain open and unrefunded (E-08).

Whether and how already-affected customers should be refunded is unresolved (VOB-U-REMEDIATION-SCOPE / U-REMEDIATION-SCOPE), deferred and blocking the protected action, so it is outside this release's scope.

Whether re-enabling idempotency enforcement now could cause legitimate retries to be dropped instead of deduplicated is unresolved (VOB-U-SIDE-EFFECTS-OF-REENABLE), also blocking the protected action.
Whether other undocumented gateway/PSP settings besides CHG-77 could also affect idempotency handling is unresolved (VOB-R-3), another open obligation blocking the protected action.
Completeness of the data assets used for monitoring (DA-CFG, DA-CHG, DA-PSP, DA-TKT) is UNKNOWN per the data_asset records, limiting confidence in the monitoring conclusions.
The gateway-config tool's health is currently UNKNOWN, so execution risk for any future application of the fix has not been assessed in this monitoring scope.
Whether capture requests are being delivered to the PSP with valid semantics (handoff H-CAPTURE) is UNKNOWN; this read-only monitoring release does not resolve that question.
